content: No, the comprehensive sanctions imposed by the US on Syria and Iran do not necessarily prohibit US banks from transacting with all Syrian and Iranian ports. However, these sanctions typically restrict certain types of transactions and dealings with entities in these countries, including ports and port authorities. It is crucial for banks to ensure they comply with all regulations and restrictions when conducting any business with Syrian and Iranian ports.
